objective: Standard statement: by SAT with sound symmetry breaking, replayed with a second solver: no connected non-2-colourable 3-regular triple system on n points for n in 3..12 except n = 7 (the Fano plane); on 13 points exactly one up to isomorphism, the Fano splice; no twisted one (one complemented incidence) on at most 13 points. (A's reduction cannot extend this: see ticket C.) Knot side: the three-fold odd gadgets exact at the knot with distinct corner triangles up to 13 triangles; mixed (phase-pure) gadgets up to six triangles. Nearest known result: ticket A. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001B-P001 (V1): by SAT with sound symmetry breaking, replayed with a second solver and without symmetry breaking, the connected cubic triple systems that are not 2-colourable on at most 13 points are exactly the Fano plane and the 13-point Fano splice (unique); no twisted one exists on at most 13 points; hence the knot's three-fold spaces with at most 13 triangles are their duals (all 18 corner choices at 13 exact, lambda(0) = 25); phase-pure gadgets up to six triangles have no locks and none is exact.
title: Exhaustive classification of small three-fold spaces
